# Creative Work

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](gmeow-CreativeWork.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CreativeWork>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)

The abstract umbrella category for intellectual and artistic creations in the WEMI spine — a [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md), [`Expression`](gmeow-Expression.md), [`Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md), or [`Item`](gmeow-Item.md). Formerly a flat [gufo:Kind](../../external/terms.md#gufo-kind) (pre-); now a Category so that the four tiers with distinct identity criteria can each be a [gufo:Kind](../../external/terms.md#gufo-kind) beneath it.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md), [`gmeow:NarrativeScope`](gmeow-NarrativeScope.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](gmeow-CreativeWork.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md), [`gmeow:NarrativeScope`](gmeow-NarrativeScope.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md), [`gmeow:NarrativeScope`](gmeow-NarrativeScope.md)
